source_text: Systematic reviews of clinical data reveal complication rates exceeding 50% in infibulated women, encompassing dyspareunia, infertility risks, and fistula formation, with no empirical studies identifying hygienic, sexual, or social advantages to counter these outcomes. [73] [69]
